title: pxsig project config (pxsig.config.json)
description: Configures one project (package under test). Every key is optional. Relative paths are relative to the project folder; a path starting with "$workspace/" is relative to the workspace root.

path.description: A path relative to the project folder, "$workspace/…" relative to the workspace root, or absolute.

detailGate.description: Detail-channel rule: false turns it off, true uses the defaults, an object tunes it.

blockDelta.description: A kept tile changed when any of its blocks moved by more than this (0-255). Default 32.

energyDelta.description: A new edge appeared when a tile's edge energy rose by more than this (0-255). Default 48.

minTiles.description: Fail when at least this many tiles trip either rule. Default 3.

gate.description: Gate thresholds. An entry fails when any rule trips.

threshold.description: Per-cell mean RGB delta (0-255) that counts a cell as changed. Default 24.

minCells.description: Fail when at least this many cells changed. 0 turns the rule off. Default 3.

minSsim.description: Fail when SSIM is below this. Default 0.99.

maxChangedPct.description: Fail when more than this percentage of cells changed. Default 2.

maxEdgePct.description: Fail when the Sobel edge-map difference is above this percentage. Off by default.

globals.description: Storybook globals in URL form, e.g. "theme:dark;density:compact".

extends.description: Another mode's name: its keys are copied first. One level only.

name.description: Project name in a single-package repository. In a monorepo the key in pxsig.workspace.json is the name.

srcRoot.description: The folder whose stories belong to this project.

url.description: Where Storybook serves index.json and iframe.html.

configDir.description: Storybook's config folder; used to resolve story paths from index.json.

layout.description: package: baselines in <store>/baselines/<component>/. colocated: baselines in <srcRoot>/<component>/__pxsig__/.

browserEndpoint.description: A Playwright browser server (ws://…) to render with instead of launching a browser, e.g. the container's from `pxsig browser start`. Also --browser and PXSIG_BROWSER_WS.

waitFor.description: Extra waits, each applied when its selector matches.

minMs.description: Raise the minimum wait to this.

stableMarkup.description: Wait until the markup under this selector stops changing.

minCellPx.description: Adaptive grid: cells at least this many pixels, capped by grid. 0 turns it off.

detail.description: Write the detail channel into new baselines.

trim.description: Crop renders to their content (right and bottom). false turns it off.

modes.description: Named modes. A project's modes replace the workspace defaults and the built-in set.

defaultMode.description: The mode whose entries keep the bare story id. Default: the first mode.

modesByDefault.description: Modes every story renders in. Default: [defaultMode].

suites.description: Extra manifests (manifest.<suite>.json) for other mode sets.

workspaceDeps.description: A change in a workspace dependency's source selects every entry.

extra.description: More paths whose change selects every entry.

ignore.description: Globs for changed paths that select nothing when nothing traced claims them. Relative to the project; $workspace/ and $repo/ anchor a glob.

aliases.description: Import aliases only a bundler knows (Vite resolve.alias): specifier prefix → path. Longest prefix wins.

unresolved.description: Globs of files whose unresolved imports are accepted: they add no entries to every run. Anchored like affects.ignore.

env.description: The render environment each baseline records and each check compares (docs/configuration.md#env).

ignore.description: Fields left out of the comparison, e.g. render.timezone when no story formats a date.

fontProbe.description: Font families measured besides serif, sans-serif, monospace and system-ui (the design system's own), so a mismatch names the family.

strict.description: Refuse a check (exit 2, nothing rendered) when a selected baseline was approved in a different environment. Same as --strict-env and PXSIG_STRICT_ENV=1.

nonVisual.description: Top-level folders under srcRoot with no visual stories.

sourceRoots.description: Workspace-relative folders whose edits can make a verdict stale. Default: srcRoot.

maxTracedFiles.description: Above this many edited files, staleness uses the same-folder rule.

renderSkewMs.description: A render written this long after its verdict makes the verdict stale.

manifests.description: Other manifests (relative to the store) whose baselines are not orphans. Default: every manifest.<suite>.json.

importPathPattern.description: Advanced: a regular expression selecting the project's story files, with the component folder as group 1. Default: files under srcRoot.

identity.description: What each log line says about who approved: nothing (the commit and the pull request say who), or the git email.

level.description: standard: a typed phrase at a terminal, or the dashboard with the dashboard link. strict is reserved for a later release and refused for now.

dashboard.description: The dashboard rebuilt on this project's design system (`pxsig dashboard build`).

ui.description: The UI adapter: a path to its module (a file, or a folder with an index file), relative to this folder, or a built-in adapter's name. See docs/ui/build-adapter.md.
